title: Foreign Keys aur Table Relationships
objectives: Foreign key kyun zaroori hai samajhna
Many-to-many ke liye pivot table banana

sections.heading: Foreign key kya hai?
sections.body: Ek table ka column doosri table ki row ko point karta hai. Jaise `products.category_id`, `categories.id` ko point karta hai. Foreign key constraint database ko batata hai ki galat ya na-maujood category_id allow mat karo.

callout.text: Foreign key = database ka rule: product ek asli category se jude, hawa mein latki hui category se nahi.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Category aur Product
sections.body: Ek category ke kai products ho sakte hain. Pehle `categories` banao, phir `products` jo us par depend karti hai. **Parent table ki migration pehle chalni chahiye.**
explain: `constrained()` – column ke naam (`category_id`) se table `categories` guess karke foreign key banata hai.
Table ka naam alag ho to `constrained('product_categories')`.
`cascadeOnDelete()` – category delete ho to uske products bhi delete.

sections.heading: On delete ke options
sections.body: Parent delete hone par child ka kya ho:

code.code:
$table->foreignId('category_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete();   // products bhi delete
$table->foreignId('brand_id')->nullable()->constrained()->nullOnDelete(); // brand_id NULL ho jaye
$table->foreignId('seller_id')->constrained()->restrictOnDelete();   // delete rok do

explain: `restrictOnDelete` – child hone par parent delete nahi hone dega.

sections.heading: Many-to-many: pivot table
sections.body: Ek product kai tags ka ho sakta hai aur ek tag kai products ka. Beech mein pivot table banti hai. Naam do models ke naam alphabetical order mein, singular: `product_tag`.

sections.heading: Foreign key hatana
sections.body: Rollback ya badlaav mein foreign key ko sahi tareeke se drop karna padta hai:

versionDiff.heading: Foreign keys: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: `foreignId()->constrained()` aur on-delete helpers teeno versions mein same hain.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[HY000]: General error: 1215 Cannot add foreign key constraint
errors.cause: Parent table pehle nahi bani, ya dono columns ke type alag hain.
errors.fix: Migration order theek karo (parent pehle) aur `foreignId()` use karo jo `id()` ke type se match karta hai.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 1451 Cannot delete or update a parent row
errors.cause: Child rows hain aur constraint `restrict` hai.
errors.fix: Pehle children delete karo ya `cascadeOnDelete()` lagao.

errors.error: Base table or view not found: 1146 Table '...categories' doesn't exist
errors.cause: `constrained()` ne jo table guess ki woh maujood nahi (ya naam alag hai).
errors.fix: `constrained('sahi_table_naam')` likho aur migration order check karo.

debug.body: Foreign keys aur structure dekhne ke liye:

code.code:
php artisan db:table products
php artisan migrate:status
php artisan migrate:fresh

tasks: `categories` migration banao, phir `products` mein `category_id` foreign key jodo
`migrate:fresh` chalao aur `db:table` se foreign keys dekho

quiz.why: Laravel `category_id` se `categories` table guess karta hai.
Beech mein pivot table banti hai jisme dono tables ke ids hote hain.

quiz.q: Foreign key wali table ki migration kab chalni chahiye?
quiz.why: Parent table pehle bani honi chahiye, isliye child ki migration baad mein.

interview.a: Ek table ka column jo doosri table ke primary key ko point karta hai aur data integrity banaye rakhta hai.
`cascade` mein child rows bhi delete hoti hain. `nullOnDelete` mein child ka foreign key NULL ho jaata hai.
Many-to-many relation ke liye beech ki table jisme dono taraf ke ids hote hain.
Column ke naam se (`category_id` -> `categories`). Alag ho to naam khud do.

interview.q: Foreign key constraint error ka aam wajah?
interview.a: Parent table ka order, type mismatch, ya na-maujood id.

summary: Foreign key data ko consistent rakhta hai.
Pivot table `a_b` naam se, dono foreign keys ke saath.
